audit.summary: One Major core proof defect and two Minor construction or applicability defects are established. Verified repairs preserve the relevant gain, finite-prefix existence, and scale dependence. No principal-theorem counterexample was established; the prescribed-time bridge and width inequality retain their precise proof limits.

Overly narrow almost-tiling gap selection — Counterevidence: The widened window has the same strict lower separation and same N.
Degenerate finite-prefix first-return construction — Counterevidence: This refutes the printed initial construction, not existence of suitable return domains.
Degenerate finite-prefix first-return construction — Counterevidence: The n>=4 construction and asymptotic Corollary10.3 are unaffected by a finite prefix.
Siegel-scale cutoff starts one level too early — Counterevidence: Setting S=M+1 restores the exact scale condition.
Siegel-scale cutoff starts one level too early — Counterevidence: The transition losses C1=C(tau-1), C2(t)=4C^(tm+1) and uniform modulus dependence remain valid.
Limits: No false proposition or arbitrary branched-map monotonicity established; separate E-absorption proof not fully reconstructed.
Limits: The literal set inclusion was neither proved nor refuted.
Limits: Not a failure of Proposition4.2 or Covering mechanism.
P01 — Counterevidence: This refutes the intermediate combinatorial construction, not a rational map satisfying an arbitrary large-width hypothesis and not Theorem A itself.

P02 — Counterevidence: This is a finite-prefix construction defect, not proof that the asserted return map cannot exist. Corollary10.3 uses a subsequential limit and is unchanged after deleting finitely many levels.
P03 — Counterevidence: This is an applicability mismatch, not a numerical counterexample to the a priori bound. The neighboring-level estimate on sourcep46 absorbs the same fixed transition factor.
Limits: Peripheral E-absorption/canonical reidentification in Section7.1 not independently reconstructed in full.
Limits: Literal arbitrary-lamination outer-buffer/subfamily assertion on pp19-20 remains unverified; a sufficient rectangular-wave replacement is checked.
Limits: External foundational and long realization theorems are invoked with checked needed hypotheses, not fully independently reproved.

proposition.claim:
The principal family has fixed local degrees \(d_0,d_\infty\geq2\) at the superattracting fixed points \(0,\infty\), total degree \(d=d_0+d_\infty-1\), and an invariant separating Herman ring of rotation number \(\theta\). Every remaining critical point lies on its two boundaries. The rotation is of bounded type; write \(B=\sup_j a_j<\infty\) for its continued-fraction bound. Theorems for this family are not statements about arbitrary rational Herman rings.

Use the source conventions \(q_{-1}=0\), \(q_0=1\), \(q_n=a_nq_{n-1}+q_{n-2}\) and \(l_n=|q_n\theta-p_n|\). Lengths on the distinguished invariant set are measured in the rotation coordinate. Constants described as absolute may depend on \(d_0,d_\infty,B\). A quasicircle, a closed thick ring, and a boundary circle at the Siegel scale are different geometric cases. In particular, the latter scale requires the interval length to be no greater than the ring modulus.

The extremal width \(\mathcal W\) is the reciprocal of extremal length. For canonical horizontal types \(A,B\) the weighted quantity is \(Z=\mathcal W(A)+2\mathcal W(B)\), so \(\mathcal W\leq Z\leq2\mathcal W\). For positive numbers write \(a\oplus b=ab/(a+b)\). The distinction between total covering degree and local degree over a marked collar is essential: thresholds can depend on the former, whereas the multiplicative gain used for uniform amplification must use the latter.

For tau=10, choose N=floor(lambda/(3 tau^2)) almost-tiling pieces with consecutive gaps in ((tau-1)l_n,tau l_n].

bounded-type rotation; golden mean is allowed with B=1. even n>=8, arbitrarily deeper than the finite deep-case threshold. level-n pieces of positive angular length l_n, time indices 0<=i<q_(n+1). fixed sufficiently large lambda with N>=5.

repair.content:
Use greedy gaps in ((tau-1)l_n,(tau+1)l_n].

For n<=3 choose uniformly separated concentric target disks in the normalized quasiconformal coordinate, then take the connected pullback containing c0.

Use N<=n<S for Herman scale and n>=S for Siegel scale, S=M+1; replace the undefined N1 cutoff by S.
